title: Control Center
subtitle: Platform administration. Separate from every restaurant workspace — actions here are audited.

plansPage.title: Plans & pricing
plansPage.subtitle: Manage subscription plans, features, pricing and limits. Changes are tracked and require justification. Stripe is disconnected — all pricing is simulated.
plansPage.simBanner: Stripe is not connected. All pricing shown is simulated and does not affect billing.
plansPage.comparisonHint: Side-by-side view of what each plan includes.
plansPage.historyHint: All plan modifications with author, reason and status.
plansPage.author: Author
plansPage.editDescription: Changes are saved as drafts first. Publishing applies them and records in the audit log.
plansPage.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this change being made?
plansPage.draftBanner: This plan has unpublished changes. Review and publish or discard them.
plansPage.confirmPublishBody: Published changes are recorded in the audit log. Existing subscribers will NOT be affected without explicit authorization.
plansPage.confirmDeactivateBody: Deactivated plans cannot be selected by new subscribers. Existing subscribers are not affected.
plansPage.confirmActivateBody: This plan will become available for new subscriptions.
plansPage.impactHint: Estimated effect on existing customers. This is a simulation — no changes are applied.
plansPage.noImpact: No existing customers on this plan.
plansPage.existingWarning: Changes do NOT apply to existing subscribers without explicit authorization.

edit.title: Manage {{name}}
edit.description: Changes apply immediately and are recorded in the audit log.
edit.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this change being made?
edit.limitHint: The plan sets the store allowance. Changing the number creates an audited custom limit.

assign.title: Assign owner of {{name}}
assign.description: Only after the owner's identity has been verified outside the app. The person must already have a confirmed Servora account.
assign.notePlaceholder: How was identity verified? (e.g. ID + business registration checked on call, ticket #)

admins.intro: Platform roles are never granted at sign-up. Only an existing platform administrator can grant one, and the last administrator cannot be removed.
admins.grantHint: The person must already have a confirmed account.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.reason_required: Please give a reason (at least 3 characters).
errors.verification_required: Describe how identity was verified (at least 10 characters).
errors.user_not_found: No confirmed account uses that email.
errors.last_admin: The last platform administrator can't be removed.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

saved: Saved and recorded in the audit log.

overview.title: Platform overview
overview.subtitle: Customer organizations, usage and platform activity. Demo tenants are counted separately and never included in customer or revenue figures.
overview.revenueOff: Billing is not connected, so there is no actual revenue to report.
overview.projected: Projection at list prices: {{value}} — not revenue
overview.placeholderPricing: List prices are placeholders and not final. Projections are estimates for planning only.
overview.conversionHint: Customer organizations only. Conversion requires connected billing.
overview.attentionHint: Suspensions, missing owners, trials ending, over-limit stores and payment issues.

orgsPage.subtitle: Every registered organization with plan, ownership, trial and location usage. Opening an organization shows administrative metadata only — never its business data.
orgsPage.search: Search by name or owner email

detail.privacy: Platform administrators see administrative metadata only. Sales, orders and team details stay private to the organization.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}
suspend.description: Members keep read access but every change is blocked until reactivation. Recorded in the audit log.
suspend.reactivateDescription: Restores normal operation for this organization. Recorded in the audit log.

auditPage.subtitle: Immutable record of sensitive changes: memberships, invitations, ownership, plans, limits and platform roles.

settings.subtitle: Platform identity, plan definitions, integration status and the security controls enforced by the backend.
settings.identityHint: Shown across sign-in, emails and the Control Center.
settings.integrationsHint: Nothing paid or external is activated without your authorization.

int.authEmailDetail: Configuration and delivery have not been verified in this session.
int.googleDetail: Configuration and delivery have not been verified in this session.
int.microsoftDetail: Configuration and delivery have not been verified in this session.
int.stripeDetail: Disconnected. Test mode is prepared and needs your authorization.
int.emailDetail: Configuration and delivery have not been verified in this session.

settings.plansHint: Per-location monthly pricing in USD. Definitions change only through a reviewed backend update.
settings.securityHint: Declared safeguards, not live security checks.

sec.confirm: New accounts must confirm their email before signing in.
sec.noAutoAdmin: Platform roles are never granted at sign-up; the first-admin setup is one-time and audited.
sec.isolation: Organization data is readable only by its members. Platform admins receive no tenant access.
sec.storeScope: Managers and staff see only the stores they are assigned to.
sec.auditImmutable: The audit log cannot be edited or deleted by any app user.
sec.reasons: Every platform change requires a written reason.
sec.lastOwner: The last owner and the last platform administrator cannot be removed.
sec.suspension: Suspended organizations and inactive subscriptions cannot make changes; past-due access follows the configured grace rules.

settings.authorizationNote: Connecting payments, email or other external services always requires your explicit authorization.
